{{Transcript|text= Scriptname MoleratDirtFXScript extends Actor {Adds and manages the dirt on molerats} Armor Property SkinMoleratDirt Auto VisualEffect Property MoleratDirtParticlesE Auto Int stepper = 2 Event OnDying(Actor akKiller) if MoleratDirtParticlesE MoleratDirtParticlesE.Stop(self) GotoState("done") endif EndEvent Event OnUnload() UnregisterForAllHitEvents() EndEvent Auto State active Event OnLoad() ;Register for ambush event. ; RegisterForAnimationEvent(self, "Open") ;;;self.equipItem(SkinMoleratDirt) if Is3DLoaded() MoleratDirtParticlesE.Play(self) RegisterForHitEvent(self) ; listen for a single event EndIf EndEvent Event OnGetUp(ObjectReference akFurniture) Self.playSubgraphAnimation("stage" + stepper) debug.trace("I woke up....stage" + stepper) stepper = stepper+1 endEvent Event OnHit(ObjectReference akTarget, ObjectReference akAggressor, Form akSource, Projectile akProjectile, bool abPowerAttack, bool abSneakAttack, bool abBashAttack, bool abHitBlocked, string asMaterialName) if (stepper == 4) utility.wait(3) MoleratDirtParticlesE.Stop(self) self.unequipItem(SkinMoleratDirt) GotoState("done") elseif (stepper = stepper+1 GotoState("inActive") else RegisterForHitEvent(self) ; listen for a hit again... endif EndEvent EndState State inActive Event OnBeginState(string asOldState) utility.wait(2) debug.trace("FinishedWaiting" + stepper) GotoState("active") RegisterForHitEvent(self) ; listen for a single hit EndEvent endState State done ;do nothing endState }}

The multi-generational starship was a long-term plan by the Enclave to address the problem of Earth's destruction in the wake of a global thermonuclear war. Fearing that the war would render the surface of the world uninhabitable, the Enclave elected to create an interstellar vessel to take the "best and brightest" off world to a new planet that could be colonized and human civilization started anew. Lacking the know-how on how to build this vessel, beyond using nuclear engines to power it for centuries, Vault-Tec worked with the Enclave to turn Project Safehouse from a limited preservation program into a vast social experiment to provide the necessary data to build the starship: How to store most of the colonists in cryonic suspension without damage, how to organize the crew maintaining the ship over multiple generations, how to grow food and recycle water and air in a closed environment, and test the practical limits of the weapons. Control Vaults like Vault 8 were set up to study human behavior when recolonizing the surface. Ultimately, while the Vault experiments were implemented by Vault-Tec and fed data to the Enclave Vault-Research Control on the oil rig, the starship never materialized. Whether it was a lack of time to implement it, or sabotage of Enclave facilities meant to link Enclave hubs together - especially the beating heart of their master plan - the Enclave has not pursued offworld colonization, instead focusing first on continuing the war against China, then

This script is an effect script (SCN) that manages image space visual effects during the Weapon binding ritual performed by the Courier in Honest Hearts. It applies a binding distortion modifier to the player's screen on effect start and, on finish, plays a ritual sound while transitioning to a fade-out modifier.

This script is an object script (SCN) attached to the Spore Carrier Burst effect in the Honest Hearts add-on for Fallout: New Vegas. When the effect starts (typically triggered when a Spore Carrier dies or explodes), it spawns an explosion at the carrier's location (SporeCarrierBurstExplode) and instantly kills the Spore Carrier with no XP reward.

This script is attached to a magic effect for an acid-based weapon or ability, likely used by enemies or the player in the Big MT. It displays a message when the effect hits a target and periodically plays a “sizzling” sound to simulate ongoing acid damage.

This script, used in the Old World Blues add-on, is attached to an activator object representing the floating spine in a body part tank in The Sink. It controls the spine’s display animation and displays context-sensitive messages when the player interacts with the tank, based on the quest state of Old World Blues.

This script, used in the Old World Blues add-on, is a timer quest script. It manages the initial opening sequence of the player’s brain tank in the Forbidden Zone dome during the quest Old World Blues, ensuring a brief delay before enabling dialogue with the player’s brain and marking the tank as active.
The napalm payload is a weapon mod for the Hellstorm missile launcher, introduced in the Fallout 76 update Steel Dawn.
The nail gun is a weapon Makeshift Weapon Pack. It was added in the next-gen update.

This script is an object script (SCN) attached to the test item (typically the stealth suit) in the X-13 Research Facility during Old World Blues in Fallout: New Vegas. When added to the Courier's inventory, it advances objectives in both the main NVDLC03X13Setup quest and the NVDLC03MQ04 questline ("X-13: Attack of the Infiltrator!"). Depending on the current test stage and replay status, it: *Completes basic, advanced, or expert stealth objectives. *Awards XP, adds items to the starting safe, shows perk messages, and plays upgrade barks from the Stealth Suit Mk II. *Updates diagram panels, unlocks doors, turns off laser emitters, resets robots, and triggers the Robo-Scorpion attack sequence. *Increments related challenges (NVDLC03ChallengeX13Testing01/02).

This script is attached to the Bowie knife weapon in the game world. It manages the application and removal of a special actor effect based on whether the player has the weapon equipped or sells it, ensuring the effect is active only when the weapon is in use.
